caption:
A whole room of faces, and none of them looked away.

#newyorkcity #sculpture #museum
alt_text: From behind in a narrow aisle of white plaster casts on tall shelves: a woman whose bare back, arms and carved updo are polished grey-ivory marble with thin gold veins stands in a deep blue velvet gown, looking up at a large plaster head.
